countries_thin_or_null: Bangladesh — CPI now explicitly uses COICOP (12 groups) after 2021-22 rebase, but no separate detailed methodology PDF naming the exact COICOP edition beyond the classification name itself
Bhutan — CPI classified under COICOP 1999; recent HCES 2025 designed on COICOP 2018 but the published CPI series still references 1999

proposed_reports.title: Balance of Payments Statistics of Pakistan
proposed_reports.description: Annual and quarterly balance of payments and related external sector statistics compiled by the State Bank of Pakistan.

proposed_reports.title: Consumer Price Index (CPI) of Bangladesh (2021-22 base)
proposed_reports.description: Monthly national, urban and rural Consumer Price Index series rebased to 2021-22, classified into 12 COICOP groups.

proposed_reports.title: Colombo Consumer Price Index (CCPI) and National Consumer Price Index (NCPI)
proposed_reports.description: Monthly consumer price indices (CCPI for urban Colombo and NCPI for national coverage) classified according to COICOP.

proposed_reports.title: Balance of Payments Statistics of Sri Lanka
proposed_reports.description: Quarterly and annual balance of payments statistics compiled by the Central Bank of Sri Lanka.

proposed_reports.title: Consumer Price Index of Nepal
proposed_reports.publisher: Nepal Rastra Bank / National Statistics Office
proposed_reports.description: Monthly national CPI (and regional variants) with updated basket and weights from NLSS-IV, following COICOP 2018.

proposed_reports.title: Consumer Price Index of Bhutan
proposed_reports.description: Monthly national and regional CPI series classified according to COICOP 1999, with weights from BLSS.

proposed_reports.title: Balance of Payments Statistics of Maldives
proposed_reports.description: Balance of payments and related external sector statistics compiled by the Maldives Monetary Authority.

dependencies.basis: State Bank of Pakistan explicitly states that BOP statistics are compiled according to the IMF BPM6.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The Balance of Payments statistics is compiled according to the guidelines of the latest edition of the IMF‘s manual on Balance of Payments and International Investment Position, 6th edition (BPM6)

dependencies.basis: BBS CPI releases and methodology notes state that the national CPI is calculated using weight factors based on the Classification of Individual Consumption by Purpose (COICOP) with 12 major categories after the 2021-22 rebase.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The national CPI is calculated by combining the urban and rural indices using weight factors based on the Classification of Individual Consumption by Purpose (COICOP).

dependencies.basis: DCS documentation for CCPI and NCPI states that items are categorised into 12 groups using the internationally recommended Classification of Individual Consumption according to Purpose (COICOP).
dependencies.evidence_quote: There are 12 major expenditure groups covered in both indices and its classification is aligned with the United Nations’ Classification of Individual Consumption According to Purpose (COICOP).

dependencies.basis: IMF DSBB SDDS metadata for Sri Lanka states that quarterly balance of payments statistics are prepared in compliance with BPM6 from 2012 onwards.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Quarterly balance of payments statistics are prepared in compliance with the Balance of Payments Manual Sixth Edition (BPM6) from years 2012 onwards and commenced publication from 2014.

dependencies.basis: Nepal Rastra Bank technical note on the updated CPI states adherence to the UN Classification of Individual Consumption according to Purpose (COICOP), 2018 Guidelines.
dependencies.evidence_quote: the updated methodology adheres to international standards and ... the UN classification of Individual Consumption according to Purpose (COICOP), 2018 Guidelines.

dependencies.basis: NSB CPI reports explicitly state that items are classified according to the Classification of Individual Consumption According to Purpose (COICOP) 1999.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The items in the CPI are classified according to the Classification of Individual Consumption According to Purpose (COICOP) 1999.

dependencies.basis: IMF DSBB e-GDDS metadata for Maldives states that the methodological framework for BOP is defined in the IMF’s BPM6; MMA publications confirm the shift from BPM5.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The methodological framework followed in the compilation of the Balance of Payments is defined in the IMF’s Balance of Payments and International Investment Position Manual, 6th edition (BPM6).
